settings.rollNumberSlipInstructions:
Candidates must reach their respective examination room at least 15 minutes before the commencement of the paper.
1.	Students will not be allowed to enter the examination room after the paper has started. In case of delay, entry may only be allowed with the permission of the invigilator.
2.	Cheating or talking during the examination is strictly prohibited. Any student found involved will have their paper cancelled immediately.
3.	Students must bring only necessary stationery (pen, pencil, eraser, etc.). Borrowing or lending items is not allowed.
4.	Complete silence and discipline must be maintained in the examination room at all times.
5.	Mobile phones or any electronic devices are strictly prohibited.
6.	No student is allowed to leave the examination room before the allotted time without the permission of the invigilator.
